text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important task is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can read texts in different languages. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which shows whether a review or comment is positive, negative, or neutral. Companies use this to learn how customers feel about their products. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily communication with technology is becoming easier and more helpful.
